speaker: Rosemary K. Chibota
title: A Child of God
summary: Sister Chibota teaches that every person is a beloved child of God, and that seeing people that way, as the Savior did, changes how we treat them and how we see ourselves. She builds the talk on the southern African greeting sawubona, “I see you,” and on stories of Jesus at the pool of Bethesda, a school janitor her daughter greeted by name, and President Oaks telling her she was called for who she is. She asks us this week to learn the name of someone who feels unseen, pray to see others as Heavenly Father sees them, and replace worldly labels with eternal truths.
